caption: The drawing depicts a piece of beige fabric with various embroidered elements. At the center-left, there is a large multicolored leaf consisting of green, blue, and pink shades with a stem extending to the right, leading to a large flower that is colored with red, yellow, and dark blue accents. Around the central leaf and flower, there are several smaller embroidered shapes, including blue and white teardrop forms, blue and purple clover-shaped figures, and round, concentric circle patterns in shades of red and pink. Smaller, scattered blue and yellow stitch marks and motifs are present throughout the background. The fabric surface has visible creases and folds. The overall embroidery is distributed unevenly across the fabric, with open spaces and unfinished areas interspersed among the detailed designs.
title: Crewel Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
